references.text: Describes the conquest of Sihon's cities and how they were devoted to destruction, just as mentioned in 3:6
God's command to devote the peoples of Canaan to destruction, the same principle applied against Sihon and Og
The law concerning the devotion of the peoples in the promised land, explaining the background for the action in 3:6
Israel's vow to devote Canaanite cities to destruction, the same practice carried out against Sihon
Israel's victory over Sihon, king of Heshbon, which is referred to in this verse
The devotion of Jericho with all its inhabitants, the same type of action as against Sihon's cities
Joshua's devotion of cities and kings, continuing the same practice that Moses began
Saul receives command to devote the Amalekites completely, including women and children
